purpose: Factor repeated UX decisions as capability semantics and themeable roles without forcing products to share identical controls or visual identity.

representative_consumers: AFK Agent Flow / Prompt Kit pointer selection
AFK Agent Flow / Prompt Kit keyboard selection and prompt shortcuts
AFK Agent Flow / Prompt Kit phone Go-to-P# and touch prompt selection
observed_drift: snap/reveal paths collapsed discovery chrome but ordinary desktop selection did not
viewport positioning and chrome collapse were owned by separate code paths
marker-only tests could pass while the live pointer journey still retained obstructive chrome
intentional_differences: search explicitly reveals discovery chrome because filters/search are the active task
phone keeps touch-native More and Go-to-P# controls
keyboard keeps command grammar and mouse keeps direct manipulation

surface.discovery_chrome.meaning: controls used to discover/filter content before focus

surface.focus_content.meaning: selected content that owns attention after activation

action.focus_selected_content.meaning: after canonical product selection is committed, suppress nonessential discovery chrome and reveal content identity

action.reveal_discovery.meaning: restore search/filter chrome when discovery is the active task

space.focus_clearance.meaning: clearance between persistent chrome and focused content identity

feedback.selection_state.meaning: visible and accessible confirmation of selected content

ordered_effects: consume canonical selection state committed by the product selection owner
force layout measurement after chrome state change
position selected content identity below persistent chrome

mode_adapters.mouse: direct card/control selection invokes the semantic action
mode_adapters.keyboard: selection/navigation or composed reveal invokes the semantic action without synthesizing pointer clicks
mode_adapters.phone: touch-native selection/jump invokes the same semantic action while retaining touch-specific controls

acceptance: first activation succeeds from expanded discovery chrome
reveal-discovery can restore filters/search without clearing selection
focused identity is not obscured by persistent sticky/fixed chrome
gesture disambiguation preserves double-click/open before any single-click viewport movement

global_invariant: capability -> semantic action -> mode adapter -> feedback/state
explicit recovery from focus to discovery
product selection state is committed by the product owner before the shared focus action consumes it
forbidden: forcing identical control shapes across mouse keyboard and phone
duplicating product state machines inside the shared pattern
hard-coding product brand values into the semantic contract

proof_ceiling: The contract and Prompt Kit adoption prove one reusable interaction pattern with multiple mode adapters. No second independent product was supplied, so cross-product visual/theme adoption remains unproven and must not be inferred.
